title: Death screen: dim, 'You were slain...', and the cause of death
player_outcome: When you die the screen darkens and a large red 'You were slain...' appears, with the cause underneath ('Wanderer was slain by a Zombie.', 'Wanderer fell to their death.', 'Wanderer tried to swim in lava.') and the respawn countdown. The same line goes to the chat log.
design: Move PlayerEntity out of GameWorld.cs (lines 20-~100) into src/Strata.Core/Session/PlayerEntity.cs. This is a pure move that frees space in GameWorld.cs.

New src/Strata.Core/Gameplay/Combat/Harm.cs: `enum HarmKind { Enemy, Projectile, Fall, Lava, Drowning, Debuff, Other }` and `readonly record struct Harm(HarmKind Kind, string? Source)`. Add `PlayerEntity.LastHarm`.

NpcSystem.ReportPlayerDamage(player, damage, knock, Harm harm) sets LastHarm. Callers:
- NpcSystem.ContactDamage: Enemy, npc.Def.DisplayName.
- NpcSystem.Parts BarrierEffects: Enemy.
- ProjectileSystem.HurtPlayer: Projectile, the owner NPC's name when known, else the projectile's DisplayName.
- LiquidEffects: Drowning (:113) and Lava (:143).
- PlayerController fall (game/Player/PlayerController.cs:265-269): set Entity.LastHarm = Fall before DamageDirect.
- GameWorld.TickPlayer damage-over-time: Debuff, with EffectState recording the DisplayName of the buff whose damageOverTime applied (new EffectState.DotSource).

New data/config/deaths.json with message variants per kind, using {player} and {source}. Examples:
- enemy: '{player} was slain by {source}.'
- fall: '{player} fell to their death.'
- lava: '{player} tried to swim in lava.'
- drowning: '{player} forgot to breathe.'
- debuff: '{player} was consumed by {source}.'
- other: '{player} was slain.'

New src/Strata.Core/Presentation/DeathMessages.cs: Load(IDataSource), and Format(name, harm, deaths), which picks the variant deterministically by death count. Validate that every HarmKind has at least one line.
Raise GameWorld `event Action<PlayerEntity, string>? PlayerSlain` next to PlayerDied (TickPlayer). WorldLauncher loads DeathMessages, like TownConfig.

New game/UI/Hud/DeathScreen.cs: a FullRect ColorRect whose alpha tweens 0 → 0.55 over 1 s.
- Title 'You were slain...' at 48 px in Color8(225,25,25). Hardcore reads '{Name} has perished...' with 'Hardcore characters do not return.'
- Cause line at 20 px, then 'Respawning in N' at 20 px.
- Tweens out on respawn.
- Also posts the cause to ChatLog in the Death colour.
- Replaces the _death Label (Hud.cs:114-118,213-217).
files_modify: src/Strata.Core/Session/GameWorld.cs — PlayerEntity moved out; TickPlayer DoT harm; PlayerSlain event
data_changes: New data/config/deaths.json (message templates by harm kind)
tests: DeathMessageTests: ContactDeathNamesTheEnemy (TestGame zombie contact until dead); FallAndLavaMessages; EveryHarmKindHasAMessage; VariantIsDeterministic
verification: dotnet test; headless ui.cmds and basic.cmds pass; lavapipe death screenshot
risks: The feel phase (fall/debuff damage sounds and FP hurt cue) touches the same damage call sites. Land the harm plumbing first and they add sounds on top.
Moving PlayerEntity conflicts with any open branch editing it. Announce the move and land it early in the phase.
